inputs.ground_truth: scraper/manual_detect/ground_truth.jsonl (uniformCell lines and Hyundai/Kia vPIC default lines treated as unlabelled)
inputs.mid_filings_read: NHTSA MID Part 565 files for Hyundai Motor Co / HATCI / Kia / Genesis (589 unique filings listed via the MID search API; 397+ downloaded 2026-11-05 from vpic.nhtsa.dot.gov/mid displayfile). Read: Hyundai MY1986, MY1986-97 codes, every guide MY1994-2009 (text layer), MY2010 new lines, MY2015, MY2019-2022 Veloster/Veloster N; Kia MY1995, MY2001-2009 (text layer), MY2014 Rio, MY2015, MY2016 Rio (original and revised) and the 2016 Kia submission; Genesis G70 MY2019-2027; plus a keyword scan of the 336 text-layer guides filed 2016-2026 (no 'transmission', 'manual' or 'M/T' column or name except G70 '2.0T Sport (MT)' and Soul MY2020 'LX MT, LX AT, ...'). Scanned MY2011-2014 and MY2017-18 guides were checked through vPIC's transcription of their model-series names (vpic_model_series_sweep).

answer.hyundai: The VIN does NOT encode the transmission in any model year read (MY1986-88 Excel, MY1986-97 codes, every guide MY1994-2009, MY2010 new lines, MY2015, MY2019-2027 text guides). Positions: 4 line, 5 grade/model series (cars) or model series (SUVs), 6 body type (cars) or drive (SUVs: 1 FWD, 7 AWD), 7 restraint (cars) or GVWR (SUVs), 8 engine. Manual-only cells reachable by line/drive/engine: Veloster N MY2019-2020 (KMHT3, line code). Candidates only: Tucson 2.0 AWD MY2005-2009 (sources conflict), Elantra 1.6 MY1993-1995 (no lot car). Trim-level manuals (Genesis Coupe R-Spec, Veloster Turbo R-Spec) share their code with automatic trims.
answer.kia: The VIN does NOT encode the transmission (MY1995 filing, MY2001-2009 guides, MY2010 new lines, MY2015, MY2016, MY2017-2027 text guides): 4-5 line/series, 6-7 body type, 8 engine/restraint (cars to MY2009); SUVs 4-5 line/series+drive, 6 body, 7 GVWR, 8 engine. Exception on paper: the Rio MY2014 and revised MY2016 guides name 'Manual Trans'/'M/T' (L) and 'AT'/'A/T' (M/N/P) in position 5, but real manual Rio LX cars carry M, so the wording is not reliable and that rule is dropped. Manual-only cell ruled: Sportage 2.0 4WD MY2005-2009 (J + E with engine 2/4). Candidate: Sportage 2WD 2.0 SOHC MY1995-96.
answer.genesis: The VIN DOES encode a manual for one car: G70 MY2019-2021, position 5 = 2 '2.0T Sport (MT)' (Genesis filings for MY2019, 2020, 2021). Every other Genesis code (G70 other grades, G80, G90, GV60/70/80) is automatic-only and no manual was offered after MY2021. Genesis Coupe (sold as a Hyundai, KMHH) does not encode it.
answer.vpic_already_decodes_it: vPIC returns a transmission for Hyundai/Kia only in MY2008 and MY2017+, and neither comes from a VIN position: the MY2008 values are keyed on the engine character (every 4-cylinder decodes '5-spd Manual', every V6 'Automatic'), and the MY2017+ values are model/engine defaults (for example every 2018 Elantra 2.0 decodes '6-spd Automatic' though a 6MT was offered). So every one of today's 562 Hyundai/Kia VIN-sourced 'confirmed manuals' is a vPIC default, not evidence about the car (hub_findings). The only code-level vPIC manuals are G70 MY2021 code 2 (right, wrong speed count), Rio MY2014 code L (dropped) and Elantra MY2020 code 0 'Sport' (unsupported; hub_findings.vpic_code_level_manuals_checked).

vin_scheme.transmission_character: none, in any filing read for these three makes; the only transmission wording sits inside model-series names (G70 code 2 MY2019-2021; Rio L/M/N/P MY2014 and MY2016 revised, contradicted by real VINs; Soul MY2020 code 2 'LX MT, LX AT, ...' shared).

not_encoded_or_not_ruled: Hyundai, Kia and Genesis VINs carry no transmission character, so for nearly all of these cars (Elantra, Sonata, Accent, Santa Fe, Tucson 2.4, Veloster, Genesis Coupe, Rio, Forte, Optima, Soul, Sportage 2.4 ...) the VIN cannot say manual vs automatic. Those cars need listing text, a build-sheet source, or the owner.
Kia Rio MY2014 / MY2016 code L ('Manual Trans LX' / 'LX M/T') and M ('AT LX' / 'LX A/T'): dropped, real manual LX cars carry M (rule kia_rio_code_L_lx_mt_2014_2016).

Hyundai Genesis Coupe R-Spec (2.0T and 3.8, 6MT only) and Veloster Turbo R-Spec (MY2016-2020, 6MT only): their model-series code is shared with automatic trims (Genesis Coupe 5 = T/U are GL/GLS grades; Veloster H = 'Turbo R-Spec, Turbo and Turbo Ultimate'). Not ruled.
Hyundai Scoupe Turbo (MY1993-95, EPA Manual 5-spd only): engine code N is shared with the non-turbo Scoupe/Accent 1.5 (MY1994-95 guides). Not ruled.
Kia Sportage 2.0 4WD MY2010 (EPA Manual 5-spd only): new VIN layout (KNDK..) and the MY2010 Sportage guide was not read; no MY2010 2.0 4WD Sportage is on the lots. Not ruled.
Hyundai Elantra N / Kona N, Kia Forte GT, Veloster N MY2021-22, Genesis G70 3.3T and every other DCT/automatic-only or MT-or-DCT model: no manual-only code. Not ruled.
Cars without a 17-character VIN (summary.three_make_coverage.<make>.no_vin) cannot be reached by VIN rules.
Cars at Canadian yards are scanned but not newly confirmed: the manual-only facts are US-market facts (EPA).

ground_truth_precision_manual_claims_kep.note: no in-scope car has an independent (non-vPIC-default) ground-truth label

validation_method: For each rule, every lot car is matched by WMI, valid check digit, VIN model year (character 10, listing year picks the 30-year cycle) and the fixed + coded characters. 'checkable' = its ground_truth.jsonl line has class manual/automatic/cvt/amt/dct, uniformCell is empty, and it is not a Hyundai/Kia vPIC engine-default line (source vin and vPIC make Hyundai/Kia/Genesis: no Hyundai/Kia VIN position carries the transmission, so every such vPIC value is a model/engine default; these are counted separately as 'vpic_default_lines'). Agreement = same manual-vs-not-manual answer; 'raw' agreement including the vPIC default lines is reported too. epa_cell = the EPA rows the claim rests on, re-read per model year ('manual_only' rules need EPA to list only manuals every rule year; 'manual_offered' rules need a manual row every year). vpic_check = live vPIC decode of each in-scope VIN (vin_rules_3_vpic.json): displacement / drive / engine model / trim must match the code's meaning. Status: drop when flagged (evidence contradicts the table) or when >= 20 checkable and agreement < 99.5%; candidate when flagged (evidence short of certain); low_sample when < 20 checkable (kept: the code table is the manufacturer's own Part 565 filing, and the manual claim has EPA plus an independent reference); keep otherwise. 'newly_confirmed_manual' = in-scope cars at US yards whose published extras transmission is empty today.

hk_vpic_manual_labels.what: Every Hyundai/Kia/Genesis lot car whose published transmission is a vPIC 'manual' (transSrc vin).
hk_vpic_manual_labels.finding: All of them are MY2008 vPIC values keyed on the engine character alone: every MY2008 Hyundai/Kia 4-cylinder (and the Santa Fe 2.7 V6) decodes '5-spd Manual/Standard', every other V6 'Automatic'. Neither the MY2008 Hyundai guide (ORG10864) nor the Kia guide (ORG10857) has a transmission position. The baseline flagged the 17 uniform cells; the 2008 Santa Fe 2.7 (5NMSG.3D) and Sportage 2.0 (KNDJ[EF]724) manuals sit in mixed cells (their V6 siblings decode automatic) and are the same default. Only the Sportage 2.0 4WD (KNDJE724) labels happen to be right (rule kia_sportage_20_4wd_2005_2009); the rest are not evidence about the car.
hk_vpic_manual_labels.hub_decision_needed: Whether to stop showing the Manual badge for Hyundai/Kia/Genesis vPIC MY2008 'manual' values (integration change in the scraper/app; not made here).

vpic_code_level_manuals_checked.verdict: Manual is right (Genesis filing code 2 = '2.0T Sport (MT)'; EPA 42495 Manual 6-spd); the speed count is wrong (6, not 8). Covered by rule genesis_g70_20t_sport_mt_2019_2021.

vpic_code_level_manuals_checked.vpic: Manual/Standard, 6 speeds for every VIN with position 5 = 0
vpic_code_level_manuals_checked.verdict: Not supported: Hyundai's 2020MY Elantra guide (MID ORG16557, 2019-02-06) names code 0 only 'Sport', and EPA's 2020 Elantra 1.6 turbo rows list only Automatic (AM7) (id 41454). A vPIC default; no lot car carries it today, but a future one would get a Manual badge from it.
Kia's own table, but real manual Rio LX cars carry M (rule kia_rio_code_L_lx_mt_2014_2016, dropped). No lot car carries L.

hk_vpic_automatic_labels_epa_lists_manua.what: Hyundai/Kia/Genesis lot cars with a vPIC automatic/CVT label in a year/model/displacement where EPA also lists a manual: these are vPIC defaults, so a later manual rule would show them as false 'disagreements'.

vpic_model_series_sweep.method: For each Hyundai/Kia/Genesis line (WMI + VIN 4) and model year MY2006-2026 that has a lot car, every position-5 character (33) was decoded by vPIC DecodeVINValuesBatch with that line's commonest positions 6-8 and '*' for the check digit (2026-11-05). vPIC's Trim/Series text is its transcription of the filing's model-series names.
vpic_model_series_sweep.finding: Only Kia Rio MY2014 (L '1.6 Manual Trans LX STD', M/N/P '1.6 AT ...') and MY2016 (L 'LX M/T', M 'LX A/T', N 'LX A/T Power Pkg') name a transmission in position 5 (rule kia_rio_code_L_lx_mt_2014_2016, dropped). Where vPIC returns a TransmissionStyle (MY2008, MY2017+), it is the same for every position-5 code of the line (line/engine-level default), apart from the lines listed under of_which_transmission_varies_with_position_5.
